topic: Trees communicate with each other through secret underground fungal networks
hook: Trees talk to each other underground. Scientists proved it.
script: Trees talk to each other underground. Scientists proved it. Beneath every forest floor lies a vast network of fungal threads connecting tree roots. Trees share nutrients, water and chemical warning signals through this network. A mother tree will send extra sugars to a dying seedling. Old trees warn young ones of insect attacks. Forests are not collections of individuals. They are one organism. Follow for nature facts that change everything.
